title: Decision Log Entry
description: One entry written by decision-recorder, as a single line in .claude/state/decision-log.jsonl (JSON Lines — one compact object per line, append-only). Never skipped regardless of a story's context_mode — context_mode governs what a story reads on the way in, never what it writes on the way out. Older entries get rotated into .claude/state/decision-log-archive/ by scripts/rotate-decision-log.ps1, with reasoning, alternatives_considered, and tradeoffs stripped on archival — id, date, story_id, decision, and consequences survive rotation. Entries tagged significance: architectural can be rendered as ADR files via scripts/export-adrs.ps1; the log stays the source of truth, the ADR files are a generated view.

id.description: Sequential, e.g. DEC-0001, DEC-0002. decision-recorder determines the next id by reading the current highest id in the hot log — rotation never reuses or renumbers ids, so this stays consistent across archival.

story_id.description: The story this decision was recorded during, 'program' if recorded during project-planner, or 'system' for automated log-maintenance entries such as a rotation breadcrumb.

significance.description: Set by whichever skill invokes decision-recorder, not inferred by decision-recorder itself — it doesn't have the context to judge this well, the caller does. 'architectural' marks entries worth rendering as an ADR via scripts/export-adrs.ps1 (service boundaries, data ownership, integration patterns, irreversible or foundational choices); everything else defaults to 'routine'.
